question_or_proposition: Under Part I.B (Delta-BHC Study), which obligations were applicable during Federal FY2025: (1) submission of a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water intake to EPA and NMED within six months of the permit effective date, and (2) collection and analysis of Delta-BHC samples—and under what conditions (permit effective date, plan approval status, and permit year)?
required_context: Whether and when a Delta-BHC study plan was submitted and approved
Which permit year(s) fall within Federal FY2025
Full Part I.B Delta-BHC Study text including post-approval sampling frequency and permit-year scope
notes: The nominated span establishes a time-bound plan-submission requirement; adjacent context adds staged sampling only after plan approval during permit years 2–5. This affects monitoring-obligation evaluation (B) and how to classify absent Delta-BHC results (C). No enforceable numeric discharge limit is stated in this passage (Purpose A unaffected).
